### Before Reporting an Issue
1. Check [docs/troubleshooting.md](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
2. Check [docs/limitations.md](../docs/limitations.md) — segmented HLS videos (`m3u8`) and login-walled pins are platform restrictions, not bugs.
3. Include your Chrome version, operating system, extension version (`v1.0.0`), and steps to reproduce.
